extraction_notes: Extracted catalyst-performance records for measured CO2 hydrogenation to methanol. Equilibrium CH3OH-yield curves in Figures 6c and 7c were excluded. CH3OH yield values are reported by the paper but the schema has no yield field; they are included in notes and not entered as methanol_sty. GHSV was not reported; feed flow was 80 mL/min and catalyst mass was 5.5 g, but GHSV was not computed. Some plotted values from Figures 6 and 7 were read approximately from labeled axes and marked with qualifier '~'. Selectivity basis was not defined in the provided main text, so it is recorded as unspecified.
